photoEndpoints.alt: AI-generated fashion editorial of four fictional adult women seated closely on blue cushions beside a waterfront at dusk, with the Kuwait Towers in the background. A braided woman in a pearl-white outfit with turquoise circular panels rests her head near a blonde woman's shoulder. Two women wear green, white, red and black cropped outfits; the fourth wears a copper beaded mini. Small star tattoos and RAZE marks appear, with white boots, blue pumps and rainbow platform heels partly visible.

AI-generated fashion editorial of four fictional adult women sharing a hand clasp on staggered cushioned seats in a pale stone courtyard with carved wooden doors and pointed arches. A braided woman in an emerald mini faces a blonde woman in an ivory one-shoulder outfit. The other two lean toward them in a violet top with a black skirt and a bronze mini with blue geometric seams. Rose, GRD and scorpion tattoos, rainbow pumps and platforms, and bronze knee-high boots add variety.

AI-generated fashion editorial of four fictional adult women smiling and clasping hands on cushioned seats in a pale stone courtyard overlooking a bay with boats. A braided woman wears an ivory mini with coral seams and a waist cutout. Beside her, a blonde woman wears a cobalt cropped top, white mini skort and blue knee-high boots. A woman in a coral mini leans over them, and a fourth wears a red, white and blue quartered Panama flag dress with two stars and turquoise boots.

AI-generated fashion editorial of four fictional adult women grouped closely on green cushions above canal locks in a diagonally framed view. A braided woman in a teal open-back mini faces a blonde woman in an ivory pearl-trimmed one-shoulder outfit with blue folds and a waist cutout. Another wears a quartered Panama flag mini, while the fourth leans in wearing copper with teal zigzag trim. Outstretched hands, shoulder contact, star tattoos and small agency and RAZE marks are visible.

caption: Kuwait ❤️ Panama: waterfront lights and courtyard warmth meet Casco Antiguo and the Canal. Linked hands, close glances, flag minis and sculptural heels. Fictional AI fashion. #RAZE #WorldXXXSeries
